subject: [PATCH v4 1/6] mm/memcontrol: make lru_zone_size atomic and simplify sanity check

reviews.author: Kairui Song
reviews.summary: Reviewer Kairui Song questioned the necessity of making lru_zone_size atomic, citing performance concerns and suggesting that 'long' should be used instead to avoid overhead in a busy/hot path.
reviews.raw_body:
These were all part of the MGLRU-FG prerequisite, so I sent them
together. I can split it out.

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch makes the lru_zone_size variable atomic and simplifies a sanity check in the memory control code. The change is motivated by the desire for cleaner code, as the current implementation can be costly and may not always catch actual leaks. The patch also clarifies the behavior difference between the new read-side approach and the previous update-side warning system.

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the swapoff path needs to drop the per-vswap spinlock before calling try_to_unmap(), agreed to restructure in v2.
